Challan record me rehta hai; maal bill p: The challan stays on record; the goods become pending on the bill to send again.

Companies jin ka maal rakhte hain — item: Companies whose goods you stock — used in the item editor and filters

Customer chunein ya naya banayein — udha: Pick a customer or create one — the credit runs on their account

Customer khate se nahi jura — \"Badlein\: Not linked to a customer account — pick a customer via "Change"

Customer ne nahi mani ya ab zaroorat nah: The customer did not accept or no longer needs it. The record is kept and can be sent again.
Customer rate ya quantity badalwaye to \: If the customer changes a rate or quantity, use "Revision" — the old number stays, with R1, R2 added.
Customer se kiraya lena hai to bill par: To charge the customer for hire, add a Delivery charge on the bill — challan hire isn't counted in sales.
Dabbe me kitni tiles aur kitne square fe: Tiles and square feet per box — boxes are worked out from the customer's room size
Dealer ka number likhein — mangwana ho t: Enter the dealer's number — call from here when you need to order.
Discount items se zyada hai: Discount is more than the items
Discount line se zyada nahi: Discount can't be more than the line
Do rate ek hi quantity par hain: Two rates are on the same quantity
Dobara chahiye ho to naya point laga dei: If you need it again, set a new point.
Ek ton me kitne kg: How many kg in one ton
Estimate — customer maan le to ek click: Estimate — when the customer accepts, bill in one click
Estimate jo customer ko diya jata hai —: An estimate given to the customer — if accepted, bill it in one click
Gaari, number aur driver likhein, print: Enter vehicle, number and driver, print it and give it to the driver. Press "Left".
Gaari, number aur driver likhein. Print: Enter vehicle, number and driver. Print it and give it to the driver — the receiver signs on it.
Gaari, number aur driver. Kiraya bill pa: Vehicle, number and driver. If hire was already charged on the bill, keep 0 here.
Har company ek baar — item banate waqt B: Each company once — pick it in Brand when making an item. The products list filters by brand.
Har construction site ek baar banayein —: Add each construction site once — owner, contractor and address.

Har item par size, grade ya shade naam k: Size, grade or shade shows under each item's name — 1/2" and 3/4" pipes are told apart.
Har quantity rate me kam se kam quantity: Enter minimum quantity and rate in each quantity rate
Har size ka rate aur stock alag ho to St: If each size has its own rate and stock, make size a variant in the Stock step (1/2", 3/4"…).
Har zaroori item par likhein kitna reh j: On each important item, write how much left means order, and how much to order.
Hardware me sab se zyada paisa contracto: In hardware most money gets stuck with contractors. Overdue and 90-day-old credit comes first in "Today's work".
Is bill ka sara maal challan par ja chuk: All goods on this bill have gone on challans.
Is quotation ka bill ban chuka hai: This quotation's bill is already made
Isi se agla step size, grade ya shade po: The next step asks size, grade or shade based on this, and POS shows an option to write the paint shade.
Item ka naam, size ya code likhein…: Enter item name, size or code…
Itna reh jaye to mangwayein: Order when this much is left
Itni ya zyada quantity par POS khud ye r: At this quantity or more, POS applies this rate by itself
Jaise: PPR Pipe 3/4\" ya Lucky Cement: Example: PPR Pipe 3/4" or Lucky Cement
Jawab na aaye to 2-3 din me call karein: If no reply, call in 2-3 days — big orders often come from follow-up.
Jis item par \"Bulk rate\" laga hai, POS: On items with a "Bulk rate", typing a bigger quantity at POS applies the lower rate by itself.
Jitna utra wo likhein. Kam utra to baqi: Enter how much was unloaded. If less, the rest stays on the bill for the next challan.
Jo company ab nahi rakhte use band karei: Turn off companies you no longer stock; old items and bills stay as they are.
Kam se kam ek item ki quantity likhein: Enter the quantity of at least one item
Kam se kam wali had reorder point se bar: Minimum level cannot be above the reorder point
Minimum level cannot be above the reorder point
Khaas — list me upar: Featured — on top of the list
Khatam hone ki tareekh shuru se pehle na: End date can't be before start
Kis ke liye aur kahan ka maal: Who it's for and where the goods go
Koi project nahi — bare contractor ka ka: No projects — track big contractor jobs by making a project
Koi quantity rate nahi. Jaise: 50 bag se: No quantity rate. Example: above 50 bags Rs 1,180 per bag.
Kuch nahi pohancha to challan cancel kar: If nothing reached, cancel the challan
Laal nishan wali jagah theek karein: Fix the fields marked in red
Naam, karobar, phone, CNIC ya account…: Name, business, phone, CNIC or account…
Naam, size (3/4), shade code ya barcode…: Name, size (3/4), shade code or barcode…
Naam, size ya code likh kar Enter. Catal: Type name, size or code and press Enter. If it's not in the catalog use "line without catalog" — but the item must be in the catalog to bill.
Off white, Sky blue, Base A: Off white, Sky blue, Base A
Pata aur site par kis se baat karni hai: Address and who to talk to at site — printed on the challan.
Pehle upar se shop chunein: Choose a shop at the top first
POS par bill \"Udhaar\" se banayein — ye: Make the bill with "Credit" at the POS — it shows here and in Customer credit automatically.
Print ya WhatsApp se customer ko bhejein: Send it to the customer by Print or WhatsApp, then press "Bhej di".
Purana customer dhoondein ya naam aur ph: Find an existing customer or enter name and phone. Pick a site and the address fills in.
Quantity rate asal qeemat se zyada nahi: Quantity rate should not be above the normal price
Quantity rate tab me dekhein kitne par k: See in the Quantity rate tab which rate applies at what quantity. Change it from Edit.
Quotation aur challan banate waqt site c: Pick the site when making a quotation or challan — everything adds up in this site's account.
Quotation band ho gayi — record mehfooz: Quotation closed — the record is kept

Quotation number, customer, phone ya ite: Quotation number, customer, phone or item…
Quotation par click kar ke kholein: Click a quotation to open it
Quotation par yahi naam chhapta hai: This name is printed on the quotation
Rate badalte rehte hain — quotation 7, 1: Rates keep changing — a quotation lasts 7, 15 or 30 days. Then it becomes "Expired".
Rate purane ho gaye — dobara bhejne se n: Rates are old — sending again starts a new validity period.
Rate quotation ke din ka — bill banate w: Rate as of the quotation date — this rate is used when billing
Reorder list me upar aata hai: Comes up higher in the reorder list
Sab se zyada udhaar wale contractor aur: Contractors with the most credit and old balances
Safar na hua to wajah likh kar cancel ka: If the trip didn't happen, cancel with a reason — the goods go back to pending on the bill.
Save ke baad print, WhatsApp aur bill wa: After saving: print, WhatsApp and bill from there
Shade aur finish — tinting wala shade PO: Shade and finish — the tinting shade can be written on each line at POS
Site ka naam likhein (jaise: Ahmed sahib: Enter the site name (e.g. Ahmed sahib's house, DHA)
Site ka pata likhein — driver isi par ja: Enter the site address — the driver will go here
Site par bhejna hai? Challan banayein —: Sending to a site? Make a challan — the rest of the goods can go later on a separate challan.
Site par click kar ke poora hisaab: Click a site for its full account
Site par jane wala maal, date se: Goods going to sites, by date
Site par jitna utra wo likhein. Kam utra: Enter how much was unloaded at site. If less, the remaining goods come back on the bill to be sent again.
Site par maal — bill se challan, aadhi a: Goods to site — challan from bill, partial and full delivery

Sootar aur grade — contractor isi se maa: Bar size and grade — contractors ask by this

Stock reorder point ({{reorderPoint}}) t: Stock reached the reorder point ({{reorderPoint}}) — order {{reorderQty}} {{unit}}{{value}}
